coverage.reason: Held documentation-only balance revision; no runtime, Master Specification or production changes. Check all 100 fixed level entries against the documented derivations: solo Gold/XP/item odds preserved, source defenders 1–10 retained, reduced 11–78 troop curve through 5,000 at 20 and 50,000 at 40, and exact one-million endpoint at 79. Check all 21 five-player boss entries from 5M to 40M, proportional Gold with a 25% premium, and XP pools equal to five quarters of the same-level Hero requirement with conserved integer shares. Review two-to-five eligibility, absolute and relative 10% minimums, party-size share ceilings, snapshot timing and rejection examples. Preserve consumable and box odds; validate mutually exclusive Common/Uncommon/no-box probabilities, conditional 0–10% rarity upgrade, box contents and expected permanent equipment/material output. Check extracted current NPC combat and loss allocation using synthetic profiles, production/replacement assumptions and limits, with 1,200 offline arithmetic scenarios. Identify the proposed boss-only full recovery after defeat and other Master Specification conflicts; keep solo wounds, immutable spawn versions, current combat and duplicate-settlement safeguards explicit. Verify complete branch scope and exact base. No browser, build or emulator tests apply to this document; arithmetic validation does not claim implementation or production readiness.
